<!-- AUDIO ASSETS - Add right before closing body tag -->
<audio id="soundClick" preload="auto">
    <source src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>

<audio id="soundSuccess" preload="auto">
    <source src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>

<audio id="soundNotification" preload="auto">
    <source src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>

<audio id="soundComplete" preload="auto">
    <source src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>

<audio id="soundTrump" preload="auto">
    <source src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>

<audio id="soundSophia" preload="auto">
    <source src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>

<audio id="soundJames" preload="auto">
    <source src="data:audio/mpeg;base64," type="audio/mpeg">
</audio>

<!-- Audio Controller Script -->
<script>
// ================= SIMPLE AUDIO SYSTEM =================
const AudioSystem = {
    enabled: true,
    
    init() {
        // Load preference
        const saved = localStorage.getItem('audioEnabled');
        this.enabled = saved !== 'false';
        
        // Add toggle button if not exists
        if (!document.getElementById('audioToggleBtn')) {
            this.addToggleButton();
        }
    },
    
    play(soundId) {
        if (!this.enabled) return;
        
        const audio = document.getElementById(soundId);
        if (audio) {
            audio.currentTime = 0;
            audio.play().catch(e => console.log('Audio play failed:', e));
        }
    },
    
    // Specific sounds for different actions
    click() { this.play('soundClick'); },
    success() { this.play('soundSuccess'); },
    notify() { this.play('soundNotification'); },
    complete() { this.play('soundComplete'); },
    
    // Voice-specific entrance sounds
    voiceEnter(voice) {
        if (voice === 'trump') this.play('soundTrump');
        else if (voice === 'sophia') this.play('soundSophia');
        else if (voice === 'james') this.play('soundJames');
    },
    
    toggle() {
        this.enabled = !this.enabled;
        localStorage.setItem('audioEnabled', this.enabled);
        
        const btn = document.getElementById('audioToggleBtn');
        if (btn) {
            btn.innerHTML = this.enabled ? '🔊 Audio On' : '🔇 Audio Off';
        }
        
        if (this.enabled) this.success(); // Test sound
    },
    
    addToggleButton() {
        const btn = document.createElement('div');
        btn.id = 'audioToggleBtn';
        btn.innerHTML = this.enabled ? '🔊 Audio On' : '🔇 Audio Off';
        btn.style.cssText = `
            position: fixed;
            bottom: 20px;
            left: 20px;
            background: #1a1a1a;
            border: 2px solid #ff4d4d;
            color: white;
            padding: 8px 16px;
            border-radius: 30px;
            font-size: 14px;
            cursor: pointer;
            z-index: 9999;
            opacity: 0.8;
            transition: all 0.2s;
        `;
        btn.onmouseover = () => btn.style.opacity = '1';
        btn.onmouseout = () => btn.style.opacity = '0.8';
        btn.onclick = () => AudioSystem.toggle();
        document.body.appendChild(btn);
    }
};

// Initialize audio
AudioSystem.init();
</script>
